faq.q: How much does Greco Neyland charge?
faq.a: Greco Neyland publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Greco Neyland offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Greco Neyland publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Greco Neyland have offices?
faq.a: Greco Neyland publishes two offices, in Manhattan and White Plains. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Greco Neyland?
faq.a: Greco Neyland names three attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 3 of 3 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status.

faq.q: Are the case results Greco Neyland publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Greco Neyland publishes three case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Greco Neyland?
faq.a: Greco Neyland scores 61 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, entity registration, website and footprint. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
